_comment: THE DEVICE-UNDER-TEST BINDING. All four experiments instantiate the
subcircuits this file names; none of them contains a comparator netlist.
Swapping the placeholder for the ratified design is a one-line edit here.
netlist     path relative to sim/, must satisfy the interface contract
in sim/dut/README.md (checked at load time by harness/dut.py)
id          short identifier stamped into every record and deck header
every record it produces carry a banner saying the numbers
substantiate the harness and not a spec row
params      operating-point parameters the harness emits as .param, so
all four benches bias the DUT identically without each
description: Harness-exercising placeholder: a crude resistively-loaded NMOS differential front end plus a behavioural regenerative latch. NOT a design candidate and NOT a topology proposal -- see sim/dut/README.md.
notes: dut_ib is the tail-mirror reference current forced into the `ibias` pin.
dut_vcm is the input common mode the front end is specified at. It is a property of the DUT, not of any one testbench, so it lives here.
